id: 999-倫斯特對布萊恩·博魯的反抗
theater: 威克洛郡格倫馬瑪山口

battle.name: 倫斯特對布萊恩·博魯的反抗
battle.theater: 威克洛郡格倫馬瑪山口
battle.brief: 公元999年，布萊恩·博魯自蒙斯率大軍北上圍攻都柏林，倫斯特、萊奧伊斯與奧斯萊蓋三王聯軍在格倫馬瑪山谷隘口擊潰其鋒，殺其子肯尼迪，博魯眼部受傷。卡面羅馬弩砲屬公元前50年前後的攻城器械，並不在此役現場；它代表的是攻城技術的另一條路徑——真實的攻城靠火攻、斧鑿與封鎖海陸補給線。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場衝突發生於公元999年的愛爾蘭中部與東北部，是一次聯軍對峙：一方是布萊恩·博魯的遠征軍，另一方是由倫斯特牽頭、以都柏林為根據地的聯盟。進攻方方面，布萊恩此時是蒙斯（Munster）的國王，也是全島最具實力的勢力，軍隊骨幹是蒙斯平原的步兵，輔以各地屬王臨時撥出的跟從兵，編年一律只稱「大軍」，沒有留下可核的兵員數目。守方聯軍由四股力量組成：倫斯特王穆爾哈德·麥克·芬恩（Murchad mac Finn）率領的倫斯特步兵；萊奧伊斯（Laois）王麥克·吉拉·法德里格（Mac Giolla Phádraig）所部；奧斯萊蓋（Osraige）王肯尼迪·麥克·塞萊格（Cennétig mac Cellaig）所部；以及都柏林城內的諾斯人與混居的城民，即西格特里格·西爾克比亞德（Sigtrygg Silkbeard）治下的希伯尼亞諾斯城邦。愛爾蘭方面的指揮系統是鬆散的「王—附王」結構：國王只直接指揮本部族兵，各附王憑血緣或誓約關係隨大軍作戰，並沒有羅馬式的常備指揮部與統一後勤；都柏林一方則更接近城邦體制，諾斯王權兼有世襲與選舉的傳統，另有市議會與城內守備編制，並可隨時從挪威與英格蘭方向用船運來援兵。兩種體系的落差正是此役最吃緊之處：布萊恩靠人望可以在一處湊齊四地兵力，守方則靠城牆與海路把補充送進城內。
countriesEn: This clash was fought in the middle and north-east of Ireland in 999 AD, a confrontation between two coalitions: on one side the expedition of Brian Boru, on the other a league led by Leinster and based on Dublin. On Boru's side: at that date the king of Munster, and by far the strongest lord in the island. The backbone of his host was the plain infantry of the Munster plain, supplemented by contingents detached by his subordinate kings; the annals call it only a great army and preserve no verifiable count of the men. The defending coalition had four elements: the Leinster foot under Murchad mac Finn, king of Leinster; the men of Mac Giolla Phádraig, king of Laois; the men of Cennétig mac Cellaig, king of Osraige; and inside the walls of Dublin the Norse and the mixed town population of the Hiberno-Norse city under Sigtrygg Silkbeard. Ireland's command system was a loose structure of kings and sub-kings: a king directly commanded only the war-band of his own kindred, and the sub-kings came to the field on the strength of blood ties or sworn obligation; there was no Roman-style permanent command staff and no unified logistics. The Dublin side worked rather like a city state: Norse kingship combined inheritance with election, the town had its own assembly and an urban garrison, and reinforcement could be brought by ship at any time from Norway or England. The gap between the two systems is what made this campaign tense: Boru could gather the contingents of four provinces in one place on the strength of prestige, while the defenders could keep the city supplied through its ramparts and its sea lane.
people: 布萊恩·博魯，本名肯尼迪·麥克·布萊恩（Cennétig mac Briain），出身蒙斯特卡薩爾氏系，976年成為蒙斯特王；999年他尚未被稱為至高王，而是與米斯王梅爾·謝克奈爾·麥克·多姆奈爾（Máel Sechnaill mac Domnaill）結盟，聯手對付倫斯特方面的抵抗。布萊恩在戰場上以身先士卒著稱，這一役他本人眼部受傷，多數編年記說是敗走時被荊棘所傷；同一條記載又說他兒子肯尼迪·麥克·布萊恩陣亡於格倫馬瑪。守方的關鍵人物是穆爾哈德·麥克·芬恩，這位倫斯特王自943年至1002年在位，是最擅長在各王之間周旋的老練君主；格倫馬瑪的迎擊之策出自他與兩位盟友王的共同判斷：不在都柏林城牆外硬拼，而把布萊恩的隊伍誘進通往凱里與威克洛的山谷隘口。萊奧伊斯王麥克·吉拉·法德里格與奧斯萊蓋王肯尼迪·麥克·塞萊格各帶本部前來會合，三人聯手屢次打斷布萊恩對都柏林的圍攻。值得注意的是，守城一方並非純粹的愛爾蘭人：都柏林之王西格特里格·西爾克比亞德與其兄弟掌握城政，把城牆、寺廟區與商船交給聯軍使用。倫斯特王的妹妹高姆弗萊絲·英根·穆爾哈德（Gormflaith ingen Murchada）後來嫁與布萊恩，兩家由姻親變成敵對；她在1004年之後先後以姊妹與妻子的身分周旋於兩邊，並在1014年克朗達夫之戰前企圖促成停戰而未果。
peopleEn: Brian Boru, whose real name was Cennétig mac Briain, came of the Casel dynasty of Munster and became king of Munster in 976. In 999 he was not yet called the high king; he was in alliance with Máel Sechnaill mac Domnaill, king of Meath, and it was the two of them who faced the resistance of Leinster. Boru had a reputation for fighting in the front rank, and in this campaign he was himself wounded in the eye, most annalists saying that he was struck by a briar as he fled; the same record states that his son Cennétig mac Briain was slain at Glenumma. The central figure on the defending side was Murchad mac Finn, king of Leinster from 943 to 1002, an experienced ruler skilled at playing one set of kings against another. The decision to meet Boru at Glenumma was his together with those of his two allied kings: not to fight it out in front of the walls of Dublin, but to draw Boru's host into the mountain gaps that lead toward Kildare and Wicklow. Mac Giolla Phádraig of Laois and Cennétig mac Cellaig of Osraige each brought their own men to join, and the three of them together broke off Boru's sieges of Dublin more than once. It should be noted that the city side was not purely Irish: the king of Dublin, Sigtrygg Silkbeard, and his brothers governed the city and put its ramparts, its church quarter and its trading ships at the disposal of the coalition. The sister of the king of Leinster, Gormflaith ingen Murchada, later married Boru, and the two houses were turned from allies by marriage into enemies; after 1004 she moved between the two sides as both sister and wife, and before the battle of Clondarf in 1014 she tried and failed to bring about a truce.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲（Scorpio，即扭力弩砲）屬於公元前50年前後的羅馬軍械：木製機身、扭力絞盤儲能，靠單發投射石彈或加重箭體作遠程破壞，羅馬人用它在希臘與小亞細亞拆城牆。它與本場戰爭相隔一千零四十九年，並不在999年愛爾蘭的戰場上；它在此卡的位置，是攻城技術譜系的一端——把攻城從近身砍伐轉為遠程投射與機械破壞。與之相對，真正交手的雙方裝備如下。愛爾蘭各軍的骨幹是矛兵：長身矛列成縱隊與橫線，中央矛列以盾牆護住身體，兩翼是攜弓與投石索的輕裝步兵；投石索是愛爾蘭人最具代表性的武器，一條皮帶繫石，拋擲的節奏與射程都有專門訓練。冷兵器除青銅矛頭與斧之外，還有愛爾蘭式直刃長劍，劍身窄長，適合刺穿而非劈砍；護具以皮甲為主，頭戴皮革加金屬箍的頭盔，另備木盾與編得緻密的藤盾。都柏林的諾斯人與城民則以斧、長矛、劍作戰，並依賴維京式的狹長海上戰船：既能沿東岸把援軍、穀物與訊息運進城內，也能在突發時整隊登岸，衝擊圍城者的營地。圍城手段完全是另一條技術路徑：沒有羅馬式投石機，攻方靠火——火把、油膏與火種，用來燒掉城郊聚落、冬季糧草柵與圍城者的營帳；也靠斧、鎬與繩索挖掘牆基，從壕溝下掘進土堤；再以木梯與臨時搭架貼上木柵。卡面的弩砲因此更像一面鏡子：它象徵「用機械決定城牆命運」的攻城理性，愛爾蘭人走的則是用火、斧與耐心把同一道牆慢慢燒開的路子。
kitsEn: The Roman scorpio on the card is a piece of Roman military engineering of about 50 BC: a wooden frame storing energy in a torsion skein, firing a single shot of stone or a heavy arrow bolt at long range, used by the Romans to break the walls of the Greek cities and of Asia Minor. It stands one thousand and forty-nine years away from this war and was not present on any Irish field in 999; its place on the card is at one end of a lineage of siegecraft, the end that turns siege from close chopping into long-range shooting and mechanical destruction. Against that, the equipment of the men who actually fought was as follows. The backbone of the Irish armies was the spearmen: long spears drawn up in columns and lines, the central rank protected by a wall of shields, and on the flanks lighter troops carrying bows and slings. The sling was the most characteristic Irish weapon, a thong with a stone at the end, thrown to a trained rhythm and range. Among the cold arms, besides bronze spearheads and axes, was the narrow straight Irish sword, built to thrust rather than to chop; armour was chiefly leather, with helmets of leather bound with metal, and they carried wooden shields and tight-woven wicker shields. The Norse and townsmen of Dublin fought with axes, spears and swords, and relied on the narrow Viking sea-ships: they could bring reinforcements, grain and news along the east coast into the city, and they could land a whole crew and charge the besiegers' camp when the moment came. The means of siege followed a completely different technical path. There was no Roman stone-thrower; the attack was made with fire, torches, grease and firebrands, used to burn the suburbs, the winter fodder pens and the besiegers' tents; and with axe, mattock and rope to undercut the foundations, digging from the ditch into the earthen rampart; and with ladders and improvised timber stages set against the palisade. The scorpio on the card is therefore better read as a mirror: it stands for the siege rationality of deciding the fate of a wall by machine, where the Irish took the other road and opened the same wall by fire, by axe and by patience.
tactics: 格倫馬瑪之役的戰術核心是地形。格倫馬瑪是凱里山脈與威克洛山之間的一道狹長谷地，谷底有溪流、沼澤與濕滑草地，向北即通往都柏林。布萊恩的大軍自南方沿內陸大道北上，再折向東進入都柏林；聯軍沒有在開闊平原上接戰，而是把兵力佈在谷口與兩側高地，等布萊恩前鋒進入窄地再合攏。窄地作戰有兩重效果：一是限制敵方能展開的兵力，使人多無用；二是破壞追擊的便利，潰兵無法在狹窄道路上加速，也不能像在平原上那樣被追兵長矛陣掃倒。愛爾蘭本身的戰術傳統在此發揮作用：中央重步兵縱隊加兩翼游擊兵的配置構成了聯軍的基本骨架。聯軍沒有羅馬式輪廓分明的營區，也沒有攻城器械，補給靠牛車與隨軍車隊，因此嚴重依賴道路與季節，雨季與沼澤往往比敵軍更能決定一場戰役的成敗。圍城階段的戰術則是另一套。布萊恩在1002、1003、1004年三次逼近都柏林，每次都先摧毀城郊聚落、穀倉與碼頭設施，企圖切斷城市的陸地補給，同時派戰船沿東岸巡邏，封鎖與英格蘭、挪威的航線。城內靠城牆、壕溝與寺廟區的地勢抵抗，必要時由諾斯戰船在夜間靠岸卸下援兵與糧食。這一套拉鋸在1014年克朗達夫的正面決戰中收束：雙方在泥濘中纏鬥數小時，諾斯聯盟最終崩潰。
tacticsEn: The core of Glenumma was terrain. Glenumma is a narrow valley between the Kildare mountains and the Wicklow mountains, with streams, bogs and wet grassland on its floor, running north toward Dublin. Boru's host came up from the south along the inland road and then turned east toward the city. The coalition did not engage on open plain: it posted its strength at the mouth of the valley and on the high ground to either side, and waited for Boru's leading troops to enter the narrows before closing. Fighting in a defile has two effects. It limits the number of the enemy who can be deployed, so that numbers tell for little; and it spoils the convenience of pursuit, since routed men cannot pick up speed in a narrow track and cannot be swept down as they would be on open ground by a pursuing spear column. The native Irish tactical tradition did its work here: a central column of heavy infantry with skirmishers on both wings was the skeleton of the coalition. There was no Roman-style camp laid out in a formal outline and there were no siege engines; supply came on ox-carts and baggage trains, so the army was at the mercy of roads and seasons, and in this country rain and bog often decided campaigns more than the enemy did. The siege phase followed a different set of rules. Boru came up against Dublin three times, in 1002, 1003 and 1004, and each time he began by destroying the suburbs, the granaries and the landing places of the city, trying to cut the town off from its landward supply, while his ships patrolled the east coast to close the sea lanes to England and Norway. Inside, the city held on behind its ramparts, its ditch and the rising ground of the church quarter, and when necessary Norse ships brought in reinforcement and grain by night. That deadlock was finally closed by the set-piece battle of Clondarf in 1014, fought out in the mud over several hours until the Norse alliance came apart.
data: 可查證的數字有限，只列有根據者。這場戰爭的年代，愛爾蘭三大編年（四部注釋師年表、提加納克年表、蘇格蘭編年史）一致記於公元999年，少數學者據推算差異置於1000年；月份在編年中並無記載，卡面取八月，是依愛爾蘭軍隊通常於夏末至初秋、收割前行動的季節慣例，屬推定而非記載。戰役地點格倫馬瑪距都柏林約三十公里，谷道最窄處不足以讓兩軍同時展開。兵員方面，編年一概只寫「大軍」，沒有可核的數目；可以確定的是守方聯軍至少集結了三個愛爾蘭王國的兵力，再加上都柏林城內的諾斯守軍，攻方則以布萊恩本人在蒙斯與米斯的勢力為主，兩軍同屬千人大軍的量級。傷亡方面，編年確載布萊恩之子肯尼迪·麥克·布萊恩陣亡，並記布萊恩眼部受傷；四部注釋師年表另記都柏林被圍三次，即1002、1003、1004年。到了1014年克朗達夫之戰，編年給出較具體的數字：諾斯一方陣亡約七百五十人，其中包含奧克尼伯爵西格德父子；愛爾蘭一方陣亡約二百五十人，其中就有布萊恩·博魯與倫斯特王穆爾哈德·麥克·芬恩。城防方面，都柏林諾斯城牆與土堤的考古跡線顯示，其周長約兩公里有餘，牆為木柵加土堤、外有壕溝繞行，牆內有石砌主樓，考古發掘的市區面積約十二公頃。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, and only those on good authority are given here. The dating of the war is consistent across the three chief Irish annals, the Annals of the Four Masters, the Annals of Tigernach and the Chronicon Scotorum, which all place it in 999 AD, while a few scholars argue for 1000 on the strength of other reckoning. No month is recorded, so the card takes August on the strength of the ordinary campaigning season in Ireland, late summer and early autumn before the harvest; that is an inference, not a record. The place of the battle, Glenumma, lies about thirty kilometres from Dublin, and the floor of the valley is too narrow for two armies to deploy at once. On numbers of men the annals say only great army and preserve nothing that can be checked; what is certain is that the defending coalition mustered the troops of at least three Irish kingdoms together with the Norse garrison inside Dublin, while the attacking side drew on Boru's own following in Munster and Meath, and that both hosts were of the order of thousands. As for losses, the annals certainly record the death of Boru's son Cennétig mac Briain and Boru's wound in the eye, and the Four Masters also record Dublin being besieged three times, in 1002, 1003 and 1004. By the battle of Clondarf in 1014 the annals give the more specific figures: about seven hundred and fifty of the foreigners were killed, among them Sigurd, earl of Orkney, and his son; about two hundred and fifty of the Irish fell, among them Brian Boru himself and Murchad mac Finn, king of Leinster. On the defences, the archaeological traces of the Norse wall and earthwork at Dublin show a circuit of a little over two kilometres, the wall being timber palisade on a raised earthen bank with a ditch running outside it, with a stone-built citadel within, the excavated town area covering some twelve hectares.
cause: 起因有三層。第一層是權位：布萊恩·博魯在976年成為蒙斯特王，到990年代中期，他的勢力已能與米斯王梅爾·謝克奈爾並列，甚至在998年第一次逼近都柏林，把城外聚落燒掉。都市與王朝的目標都指向同一樣東西——控制都柏林這座掌握愛爾蘭門戶與對外航線的城。第二層是貿易：都柏林是維京人建立的城邦，經營鉛礦、銀器、穀物與羊毛，同英格蘭、挪威維持航線；誰握住都柏林，誰就握住愛爾蘭對外的通道與財源。第三層是部族王權的格局。布萊恩要讓倫斯特、萊奧伊斯與奧斯萊蓋這些附王承認他的至尊地位，一路把他們拉入聯軍去對付都柏林；998年的圍攻卻暴露了隱患——這些附王不願坐看蒙斯特人佔領自己的門戶。999年的形勢因此是三方拉鋸：倫斯特系與都柏林的諾斯人有共同利益而結盟，但彼此並不信任，聯盟在戰術上表現為聯軍在前、諾斯守軍與城防在後。也正因如此，當聯軍在格倫馬瑪獲勝時，都柏林仍是諾斯人的城，而布萊恩失去的，是他最後一次能以遠征軍正面壓倒倫斯特的機會。
causeEn: The causes run in three layers. The first is authority: Brian Boru became king of Munster in 976, and by the middle of the 990s his power stood level with that of Máel Sechnaill of Meath; in 998 he came close to Dublin for the first time and burned the suburbs. City and dynasty were after the same thing, control of Dublin, the town that held the gate of Ireland and its outward shipping. The second layer is trade: Dublin was a Norse-founded city state dealing in lead, silver, grain and wool, and it kept its sea lanes to England and Norway; whoever held Dublin held Ireland's outward channels and its revenue. The third layer is the structure of the tribal kingship. Boru wanted the kings of Leinster, Laois and Osraige to acknowledge his overlordship, and he drew them into a coalition against Dublin; the siege of 998 exposed the weakness in that plan, for those sub-kings would not sit and watch Munster men take over their own gateway. The situation in 999 was therefore a three-cornered tug of war. Leinster and the Norse of Dublin had a common interest and made an alliance, but they did not trust each other, and the alliance showed tactically in the coalition leading while the Norse garrison and the city defences stayed behind. For exactly that reason, when the coalition won at Glenumma, Dublin remained a Norse city, and what Boru had lost was his last chance to overwhelm Leinster with a field army in the open.
impact: 短期看，999年這一役把布萊恩的霸權推遲，並未改變愛爾蘭的權力版圖：倫斯特系保住都柏林這一據點，得以在之後十多年維持半獨立的位置，真正的變化發生在1002年之後。米斯王梅爾·謝克奈爾死於該年，布萊恩成為無爭議的至高王；1002、1003、1004年三次圍困都柏林後，城市最後陷落，倫斯特王穆爾哈德·麥克·芬恩與其弟馬爾·穆爾達相繼被殺或淪為附庸，倫斯特自此淪為布萊恩體系下的一個藩屬，愛爾蘭王權的重心也從南方的蒙斯特逐步北移到米斯與都柏林。1014年克朗達夫之戰中，支持都柏林的諾斯聯軍（包括奧克尼伯爵西格德父子）被擊潰，布萊恩本人陣亡，但愛爾蘭聯盟獲勝；愛爾蘭的教會、主教與拉丁文獻從此把布萊恩寫成抵抗外來者的至高王，戴王冠的愛爾蘭王與羅馬皇帝同級的觀念也由此成形。長期看，這段編年記錄是研究11世紀愛爾蘭陸戰最珍貴的原始資料之一，它留下了陣形、兵器、城防與補給的細節，是後世文學與藝術不斷重述布萊恩與倫斯特對抗故事的材料來源。
impactEn: In the short run the campaign of 999 merely postponed Boru's ascendancy and changed nothing in the map of Irish power: the Leinster house kept Dublin as its anchor and held a semi-independent position for another decade or more. The real change came after 1002. Máel Sechnaill of Meath died in that year and Boru became the undisputed high king; after the three sieges of Dublin in 1002, 1003 and 1004 the city fell at last. Murchad mac Finn of Leinster and his brother Máel Mórda were killed in turn or reduced to dependence, Leinster became a subject province of Boru's order, and the centre of Irish kingship moved gradually from the south in Munster northwards towards Meath and Dublin. At Clondarf in 1014 the Norse alliance that had backed Dublin, including Sigurd, earl of Orkney, and his son, was broken; Boru was killed, but the Irish coalition won. The Irish church, the bishops and the Latin writers thereafter presented Boru as a high king who had resisted a foreign power, and the notion of a crowned king of Ireland ranking with the Roman emperors took shape from that. In the long run these annal entries are among the most precious raw materials for the study of eleventh-century Irish land warfare, preserving details of formation, weapons, fortification and supply, and they are the source from which later literature and art went on retelling the story of Brian and Leinster.
result: 結果可分三層。999年的格倫馬瑪之戰：倫斯特、萊奧伊斯與奧斯萊蓋聯軍在山谷隘口擊潰布萊恩的軍隊，布萊恩之子肯尼迪·麥克·布萊恩陣亡，布萊恩本人眼部受傷後退回；都柏林守住，布萊恩第一次大規模圍攻失敗。1002至1004年：布萊恩在梅爾·謝克奈爾死後成為至高王，連續三年圍困都柏林，逐步燒毀城郊、切斷海陸補給，最終迫使城內的諾斯王與倫斯特勢力屈服；這段時期倫斯特王穆爾哈德·麥克·芬恩維持王位至1002年，其弟馬爾·穆爾達於1004年被殺，倫斯特此後淪為附庸。1014年：克朗達夫決戰中愛爾蘭聯盟獲勝，諾斯聯軍崩潰，都柏林落入布萊恩一方之手，布萊恩本人陣亡，其子承接至尊地位。整體而言，這場由倫斯特領頭的反抗並沒有換來愛爾蘭的統一，反而是這場反抗加上隨後的圍城，讓布萊恩得以逐步消滅所有對手，把至高王從一個稱號變成實權；編年家因此把999年記為愛爾蘭史上的一個轉折：由部族聯盟走向單一權力中心的最後一場大的失敗。
resultEn: The outcome can be read in three layers. At Glenumma in 999 the coalition of Leinster, Laois and Osraige broke Boru's army in the narrow valley; Boru's son Cennétig mac Briain was killed, Boru himself was wounded in the eye and drew off; Dublin held, and Boru's first great siege failed. In 1002 to 1004, with Máel Sechnaill dead and himself high king, Boru came against Dublin three years running, burning the suburbs and cutting the land and sea supply until the Norse king inside and the Leinster party were forced to yield; Murchad mac Finn of Leinster kept his kingship until 1002, and his brother Máel Mórda was killed in 1004, after which Leinster lay as a dependent province. In 1014 the Irish coalition won the set-piece battle of Clondarf, the Norse alliance came apart, Dublin fell into the hands of Boru's side, Boru was killed, and his son took up the overlordship. Taken as a whole, the revolt headed by Leinster did not buy Ireland its unity. On the contrary, that revolt and the sieges that followed allowed Boru to remove his opponents one by one and turn the high kingship from a title into actual power. The annalists therefore entered the year 999 in Irish history as a turning point: the last great failure on the road from a league of tribal kings to a single centre of authority.
